scope: dev-only single-program eligibility v1: one active pblanc_id + one CompanyProfileSnapshot -> program-scoped retrieval -> LLM criterion comparison -> application validation and overall status -> resolved citations

profile.persistence: none; the AI layer consumes a snapshot, the service layer owns company data
profile.derived: business_age_months is computed by the application from business_start_date and as_of (Asia/Seoul date by default)
profile.missing: every field is optional; a missing value makes dependent criteria UNKNOWN

program: support_programs row must exist with source_active=1 and source_deleted=0, otherwise eligibility_program_not_found_or_inactive

retrieval.query: 지원대상 지원 자격 신청 자격 지원 요건 제외 대상 신청 제한
retrieval.rule: fixed application query (no company values, no query rewrite); Retriever scope is exactly the target pblanc_id; the retrieval baseline is unchanged

rules: one logical requirement (including an OR alternative) is one criterion
exclusion conditions are MET when the company is not in the excluded state
a required company fact that is missing gives UNKNOWN, never an inferred MET or NOT_MET
every criterion cites at least one evidence id of this request and names the profile fields it compared
criterion_output.field_ids: the model sees company facts keyed by stable field IDs (snapshot field names, business_age_months, extra_1..extra_N for additional_facts with a label legend); profile_fields and evidence_ids are restricted per request by JSON schema enum, then re-validated by the application and mapped back to the original names in the result
criterion_output.limit_basis: 2026-10-03 diagnosis (recommend Top 3, local qwen3.5:9b, 18.7 output tokens/s): normal judgments had 2, 8 and 10 criteria (170-1,000 output tokens, 9-48s); the failing program looped over 13 distinct criteria (67 criteria, 54 exact duplicates, 37 about documents) and did not finish within 5,000 tokens; another listed 37 criteria (1,735 tokens, 97s). max_criteria 12 is 20% above the largest normal count and is enforced as JSON schema maxItems during generation; max_output_tokens 1,024 covers 12 criteria at 75 tokens each (about 55s)
criterion_output.limit_rule: an output that reaches max_criteria or is cut by max_output_tokens is not judged: the evaluation fails with eligibility_output_limit_reached (fail closed) so a truncated criteria list can never become ELIGIBLE; prompt text, criterion rules and overall status rules are unchanged

fail: schema mismatch or result outside MET/NOT_MET/UNKNOWN
evidence id not in the request context
profile field name not in the snapshot facts
output limit reached (criteria count at max_criteria or generation stopped by max_output_tokens): eligibility_output_limit_reached
validation.adjust: a MET or NOT_MET criterion whose referenced profile fields are all missing becomes UNKNOWN (recorded in adjusted)

overall_status.rule: application-derived from validated criteria; the model never sets it
overall_status.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: no retrieved evidence or no criterion

explanation: assembled by the application from criterion results; no separate explanation LLM call
disclaimer: 제공된 기업 정보와 공고문을 기반으로 한 사전 판단이며, 최종 자격은 사업 수행기관의 기준 확인이 필요합니다.
